Name: Simple Notifications
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]🔔 Simple Notification History[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Missed a notification? Press [b]Alt + N[/b] to read it again, find a message and create your own reminders.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]📖 Find Your Recent Notifications[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• Search message text or a labelled mod name; filter by category and source.
• Read original messages with their game date and time, newest first. Open a row for complete, scrollable text.
• Item pickups show their recorded item artwork, including available custom sprites and retextures. Newly recorded Bookseller and fish-frenzy notices have book/fish icons beside the message. The frenzy icon is representative; older or unavailable identities use category icons.
• Keep [b]200 messages by default[/b], adjustable from 50 to 1,000. Each farmer has separate saved history.
[/color][/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53831/53831-1791884287-1858553149.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]⏰ Personal Reminders[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Open [b]Reminders[/b], write a message, choose a game-clock time and select [b]Once[/b] or [b]Daily[/b]. Add new reminders, or select an existing one to edit, switch On/Off or delete.
Passed times start tomorrow. Once-only reminders switch off after firing; missed days do not produce a backlog. Up to [b]50 reminders[/b] per farmer, with 500 characters each. Save the game to retain changes.
[/color][/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53831/53831-1791884292-1008226306.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]🧩 Messages From Other Mods[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Normal HUD notifications from the game and other mods are captured automatically. These share the [b]HUD notifications[/b] source because native banners do not identify their sender. Mods using the optional integration API can send custom messages with their own mod name and category.
Private overlays, dialogue, mail, chat and SMAPI logs require a specific integration; they are not automatically read. Recording starts after installation.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]🎮 Controls & Settings[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Mouse wheel or drag the scrollbar to browse. Select a row and press Enter/Space for full text; F focuses search, R opens reminders, and Left/Right cycle category/source filters. Controller navigation and text entry are supported.
Optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] lets you change the hotkey, history limit and pickup capture. UI text supports all twelve built-in game languages; captured messages retain their original language.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#86EFAC]🛠 Requirements & Install[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/url]. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
Extract [b]SimpleNotificationHistory[/b] into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] and launch through SMAPI. When updating, keep your existing config.json and replace the mod’s runtime files. Only one copy of this mod should be installed.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a report or suggestion on this mod's page.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]For bug reports, please include:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]• Mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform.
• What happened, what you expected and steps to reproduce it.
• A [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url], if applicable.
• A screenshot or short video, if helpful.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]For suggestions:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]Tell me what you would like added or changed and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
